span.p:
solid arrow: imported at module level · dashed: imported inside a function (lazy)
the cycles app → reports → experiments → app run only through lazy imports
drafting, llm and experiments import ingestion only for ingestion.config, so no edge is drawn
reports.runs uses llm.cli._is_pulled (a CLI helper inside library code)
each *.cli also imports modules of its own package (not drawn)
